columns.cybermarket_template|buyers|buyregistry: Unique buyer ID code, 9 chars, BUY_ prefix.
columns.cybermarket_template|buyers|buyspending: Spending level category: Low, Medium, High, Variable.
columns.cybermarket_template|buyers|mktref: Unique market reference code, 9 chars, MKT_ prefix.
columns.cybermarket_template|buyers|vendref: Unique vendor reference code, 10 chars, VEND_ prefix.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|inves: Unique investigation registry identifier. Text code with INVEST_ prefix.
Investigation status. Values: Active, Monitoring, Closed.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|lawin: Legal interest level. Values: High, Medium, Low, Unknown.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|regri: Regulatory risk level. Values: High, Medium, Low.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|compl: Compliance score, numeric value from 0 to 100.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|inves: Investigation priority. Values: High, Medium, Low.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|respt: Response time in minutes. Integer value.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|escal: Escalation level. Values: Level1, Level2, Level3.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|cases: Case status. Values: New, In Progress, Resolved, Closed.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|resol: Resolution time in hours. Integer value.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|actio: Action taken. Values: Warning, Restriction, Termination.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|follo: Follow-up required flag. Values: Yes, No.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|revie: Review frequency. Values: Daily, Weekly, Monthly.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|nextr: Next review date. Date format YYYY-MM-DD.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|datar: Data retention status. Values: Active, Archived, Deleted.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|lastu: Last update timestamp. Format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|updat: Update frequency in hours. Integer value.
columns.cybermarket_template|investigation|secre: Security monitoring reference code. SECMON_ prefix.
columns.cybermarket_template|securitymonitoring|: JSON object of threat analysis metrics.
Machine learning confidence numeric score inside JSON.
Pattern matching numeric score inside JSON.
Anomaly detection numeric score inside JSON.
Detection evasion numeric score inside JSON.
Behavioral analysis numeric score inside JSON.
Threat intelligence numeric score inside JSON.
Event correlation strength numeric score inside JSON.
columns.cybermarket_template|vendors|vendregistr: Unique vendor registry code, always 10 characters with prefix VEND_.
columns.cybermarket_template|vendors|vendspan: Integer value with 1 to 3 digits, representing a vendor span or count.
columns.cybermarket_template|vendors|vendrate: Vendor rating as a real number from 1.0 to 5.0.
columns.cybermarket_template|vendors|vendtxcount: Vendor transaction count as an integer value.
columns.cybermarket_template|vendors|vendsucccou: Vendor successful transaction count as an integer value.
columns.cybermarket_template|vendors|venddispute: Vendor dispute count as an integer value.
columns.cybermarket_template|vendors|vendplaceco: Integer count of places, values 1 through 10.
columns.cybermarket_template|vendors|vendpaymeth: Integer count of payment methods, values 1 through 10.
columns.cybermarket_template|vendors|vendchecklv: Vendor check level as one of three text values: Basic, Advanced, Premium.
columns.cybermarket_template|vendors|vendlastmom: Vendor last moment as a date string YYYY-MM-DD.
columns.cybermarket_template|vendors|mktref: Unique market reference code, always 9 characters with prefix MKT_.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|riskre: Unique risk registry identifier. 10-char code, RISK_ + 5 alnum.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|fraudp: Fraud probability score. Real number from 0.0 to 1.0.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|moneyr: Money risk category. One of Low, Medium, High, Unknown.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|linked: Count of linked transactions. Integer, mostly 0 to 49.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|txchai: Transaction chain length. Integer from 1 to 10.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|wallri: Wallet risk score. Real number from 0.1 to 99.8.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|wallag: Wallet age value. Integer with 1-3 digits.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|wallba: Wallet balance in USD. Real number, roughly 1000 to 100000.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|walltu: Wallet turnover rate. Real number, 0.02 to 49.18.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|txvel: Transaction velocity. Real number from 0.2 to 99.9.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|profil: Profile completeness score. Real number from 0.0 to 9.9.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|idveri: Identity verification score. Real number from 0.0 to 9.9.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|feedba: Feedback authentication score. Real number from 0.0 to 9.9.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|commre: Unique communication reference identifier. 10-char code, COMM_ + 5 alnum.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|txref: Unique transaction reference identifier. 8-char code, TX_ + 5 alnum.
columns.cybermarket_template|riskanalysis|networ: JSON text with network analysis, behavioral analysis, and transaction pattern category.
Network centrality score. Real number from 0.01 to 99.93.
Network connection diversity. Real number from 0.04 to 99.96.
Geographic distribution score. Real number from 0.0 to 99.9.
Temporal pattern score. Real number from 0.04 to 99.97.
Behavior consistency score. Real number from 0.02 to 99.98.
Transaction pattern category. One of Normal, Suspicious, High-risk.
Cluster coefficient. Real number from 0.0014 to 0.9994, or null.
